en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large spa or bathhouse building with a long, two‑storey façade and steep tiled roof, set behind landscaped gardens and trees. People are visible in the foreground and near the entrance. Printed multilingual captions identify the scene as a spa complex (Curhaus) in Varaždinske Toplice/Warasdin-Töplitz. There is a handwritten date at the top (18. VII. 1905.) and a cursive message across the lower portion of the image.
